page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor operating at up to 3.525 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. Built on x86_64 architecture, it delivers 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 24 physical cores with 2 threads per core. Memory capacity is substantial, providing 384.0 GB of RAM configured at an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Local temporary storage is integrated directly via a 1933 GB SSD, supporting temporary scratch space and caching needs, while GPU accelerators are absent from this configuration.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong raw computational and memory capabilities. The instance scores in the top 25% for PassMark CPU (51437.1) and memory performance (2931.27), alongside strong stress-ng single-core (2702.58) and multi-core (64765.28) output. Encryption performance is reinforced by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instructions, achieving 51420.58 in the PassMark encryption test. Data processing throughput is solid, highlighted by strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 245.66 GB/sec and small-model LLM generation at 304.6 tokens/sec.

Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 94.97 GB/sec, while write operations hit 45.98 GB/sec. Application-level evaluations show average-tier results for database operations (19875.43), Redis SET workloads (47.33 million ops/sec), and static web delivery (28.26 GB/sec). Advanced instruction extensions include standard AVX, but lack AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets, bounding performance for tasks reliant on those specific vector instructions.

With a high 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU distribution paired with direct high-capacity local SSD storage, the E48ads_v5 offers an effective resource balance for memory-heavy requirements. It is well-matched for large relational databases, in-memory analytical stores, data engineering pipelines, caching layers, and high-concurrency enterprise applications.
description: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores) clocked at 3.525 GHz. It features 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside an integrated 1933 GB local SSD. It includes no hardware GPU acceleration. Performance evaluation highlights strong PassMark CPU (51437.1) and memory marks (2931.27), accompanied by high-tier multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 245.66 GB/sec and strong stress-ng multi-core execution (64765.28). While the AMD processor lacks AVX-512 extensions, it incorporates AES-NI and SHA-NI cryptographic hardware support, driving top-tier encryption metrics. The combination of dense memory and local high-capacity storage fits in-memory caching systems, enterprise relational databases, big data analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise software deployments.
